verdict.rationale: The Gemini API video docs include a migration notice telling users to move to a versioned model ID (gemini-omni-1.1-flash) or to GA models 'to avoid service interruptions.' That implies versioned model endpoints and an active deprecation path, but no formal deprecation policy is documented. Missing for 10: a written deprecation policy with notice periods and timelines, explicit API versioning scheme documentation, a stable vs preview lifecycle definition, and independent corroboration.
